blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Northern Hemisphere winter occurs when the Earth is near perihelion.
The distance between Earth and the Sun does NOT cause the change of seasons.
The occurrence of winter during the closest approach (perihelion) proves orbital distance is not responsible for seasonal temperatures.
Exams frequently test the misconception that Earth is farthest from the Sun during winter; in fact, Northern Hemisphere winter occurs near perihelion.
Remember that variation in Earth-Sun distance is NOT the cause of seasons.
